title: Y&R: Sally's Thanksgiving Tears Expose Billy's Hidden Chancellor Obsession
summary: Sally thought Billy had finally chosen their family over Chancellor. But one Thanksgiving conversation with Jack exposed a painful truth she cannot ignore.
body:
The Young and the Restless delivered a heartbreaking Thanksgiving surprise on November 24, and Sally Spectra found herself facing a painful reality about her marriage to Billy Abbott. While the Abbott family gathered to celebrate the holiday, Sally discovered that her husband's determination to reclaim Chancellor was far from over.

For Sally, the revelation was particularly devastating because she believed Billy was finally ready to prioritize their family and build a different future.

### What Just Happened in Genoa City?

Sally had been looking forward to celebrating Ruby's first Thanksgiving with Billy and their extended family. She had already made her position clear about Billy's business ambitions. She supported his plans to establish something new, provided that Chancellor wasn't part of the equation.

Unfortunately, Jack Abbott understood that his younger brother wasn't being entirely honest.

Jack knew Billy was still pursuing Chancellor, despite the promises he had made to Sally. Diane also believed Sally deserved to know what was happening. Although Billy had specifically asked Jack to keep his secret, Jack struggled with the idea of watching his brother celebrate his family while concealing something so important.

Eventually, Jack confronted Billy about his deception.

Sally overheard the conversation and discovered that Billy's attachment to Chancellor remained stronger than she had imagined. Billy rejected Jack's suggestion that the company meant more to him than Sally and Ruby. However, his immediate insistence that Chancellor belonged to him made his defense difficult to believe.

### Billy's Words Don't Match His Actions

Billy may genuinely believe that his wife and children come first. However, his decisions tell a more complicated story.

He had an opportunity to be honest with Sally about his intentions. Instead, he asked Jack to protect his secret, suggesting that he understood exactly how his wife would react.

That decision matters because Sally had already established a boundary. She wasn't demanding that Billy abandon his ambitions entirely. She simply didn't want Chancellor to become another destructive obsession controlling their future.

Billy's refusal to let go of the company raises questions about whether he has truly learned anything from his previous struggles.

During the Thanksgiving gathering, Billy expressed gratitude for Sally, Ruby, Johnny, and Katie. He spoke as though his family was unquestionably his greatest priority.

But Sally was listening with an entirely different understanding of his words.

### What Could Happen Next for Sally and Billy?

The most heartbreaking moment came when Sally's turn arrived at the Thanksgiving table. Overwhelmed by emotion, she couldn't get through her expression of gratitude without crying.

Traci Abbott assumed Sally was simply overcome with happiness. The family didn't realize that Sally was experiencing something much more painful.

Importantly, Sally hasn't confronted Billy about what she overheard yet. That means the consequences of this discovery remain unresolved.

However, their marriage has already entered a different emotional territory. Sally now knows that Billy concealed his continued pursuit of Chancellor, and his promises may not be enough to restore her confidence.

Could this become the moment Sally finally demands that Billy choose between his ambitions and the family they have built?

That remains uncertain. Billy clearly loves Sally and Ruby, but love alone doesn't guarantee that he will make the decisions necessary to protect their future.

For now, one thing is clear: Sally's first Thanksgiving with Ruby has become a painful reminder that her husband's priorities may not be what he claims.

And until Billy's actions finally match his promises, the future of their marriage could remain uncertain.
